profile_text: With a focus on property and land management, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced a 58.3% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in Haus- und Grundstücksverwaltungen. As a specialist in real estate activities, it has successfully expanded its operations, now employing 19 people in 2024. Its strategic location at Oststr. 162, 40210 Düsseldorf-Stadtmitte, positions it for continued growth in the region's thriving property market.
